title: Rust Remover for Crabface

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Well, look what the catfish dragged in. Lemme guess, no rust remover yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, look what the catfish dragged in. Lemme guess, no rust remover yet.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: So what you doing here? Run out of rust flakes at that bar of yours?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what you doing here? Run out of rust flakes at that bar of yours?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Huh. "Hi".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh. "Hi".

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: If you’re yanking my chain…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you’re yanking my chain…

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Yeah. Try putting bait on the right end of the rod.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Try putting bait on the right end of the rod.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Anytime, "chum".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anytime, "chum".

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Yeah? Then spit it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah? Then spit it out.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Oh, take up tap dancing. It’s always been a dream of mine, to pitter patter across a stage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, take up tap dancing. It’s always been a dream of mine, to pitter patter across a stage.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: We got a smart one. You really wanna know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We got a smart one. You really wanna know?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: ‘Cos they’re a bunch of lazy bums, that’s why. So you gonna give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ‘Cos they’re a bunch of lazy bums, that’s why. So you gonna give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: They think I’ll... go away. Once I can move.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They think I’ll... go away. Once I can move.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Never thought a Lowtown lubber would be the one to get me free of this place. I’m grateful, kid. Good luck. Go... catch yourself a future.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never thought a Lowtown lubber would be the one to get me free of this place. I’m grateful, kid. Good luck. Go... catch yourself a future.

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Soon as I can move I'm going out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Soon as I can move I'm going out. On. It ain’t rust remover in that tin. It’s the far horizon. So you... gonna give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: I'll tell ya: none of your goddam business. So you gonna give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll tell ya: none of your goddam business. So you gonna give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Karel Crabface Jones
nodes.text: Never trust a lubber. You're all the same. Get outta my goddam sight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never trust a lubber. You're all the same. Get outta my goddam sight.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually, I have it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually, I have it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not yet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not yet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just came to say hi.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just came to say hi.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I just came to say hi.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I just came to say hi.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you have any fishing tips?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any fishing tips?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you have any fishing tips?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you have any fishing tips?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I’m not. But I have a question first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’m not. But I have a question first.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I’m not. But I have a question first.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I’m not. But I have a question first.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not. Here it is.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not. Here it is.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks for nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you do, once you can move from this dock?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you do, once you can move from this dock?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will you do, once you can move from this dock?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will you do, once you can move from this dock?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why didn't your friends get this for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why didn't your friends get this for you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why didn't your friends get this for you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why didn't your friends get this for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re joking aren’t you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re joking aren’t you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go where?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry, I don't think I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, I don't think I can.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry, I don't think I can.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry, I don't think I can.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure. Here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You’re a bit too rusty to pull my leg. Or even yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You’re a bit too rusty to pull my leg. Or even yours.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You’re a bit too rusty to pull my leg. Or even yours.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You’re a bit too rusty to pull my leg. Or even yours.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And? Are they right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And? Are they right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll try to remember that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll try to remember that.

CrabfaceJones.Friend +=2; CrabfaceJones.GaveRustRemover = true;
// take rust remover
